# github_organization_outside_collaborators (Data Source)

Data source to list all outside collaborators in a GitHub organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "github_organization_outside_collaborators" "example" {
  organization = "example-organization"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The GitHub organization whose outside collaborators will be listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `outside_collaborators` (List of Object) Outside collaborators in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outside_collaborators))

<a id="nestedatt--outside_collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outside_collaborators`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `login` (String)
- `node_id` (String)
